category_title: Students who respond to microaggressions with silence or passivity
minimal_context: Julian is standing at the whiteboard in front of the whole class, tasked with reading and pronouncing the word criticism.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Julian, please read the word 'criticism' on the whiteboard for the class.

STUDENT: (Leans against the whiteboard) I don't know.

TUTOR: Just try to sound it out.

STUDENT: I don't know.

TUTOR: Stop saying I don't know, say the word!

STUDENT: crit –goddamn!

options.A: Establish a consistent routine of contacting the student's parents with praise regarding his participation in class.
options.B: Implement genuine multicultural curricula that address authentic issues of race, ethnicity, social class, disability, and so on.
options.C: Maintain a high ratio of praise statements to error correction statements during whole-class reading activities (e.g., 3:1).
options.D: Implement an in-class reward system where the student earns a sticker for accomplishing the day's reading target.
